Details.title: Details
Details.description: The full digital boarding pass payload as a JSON string, formatted EXACTLY like this: {"title":"Boarding pass","airline":"Aero Air","passenger":"J. RIVERA","from":"SFO","fromCity":"San Francisco","to":"JFK","toCity":"New York","flight":"AF128","date":"Jul 12","boardingTime":"10:05 AM","departTime":"10:35 AM","gate":"A12","terminal":"2","seat":"12A","group":"B","status":"Boarding","submitText":"Add to wallet","submitValue":"Add my boarding pass to my wallet","secondaryText":"Email pass"} Rules: - 'title' (string, optional): eyebrow above the pass. Defaults to 'Boarding pass'. - 'airline' (string, recommended): the airline / brand name shown at the top of the pass. - 'passenger' (string, optional): passenger name, shown in the times row (e.g. 'J. RIVERA'). - 'from' (string, recommended): origin airport code, e.g. 'SFO'. Shown large on the left of the route. - 'fromCity' (string, optional): origin city name shown under the origin code. - 'to' (string, recommended): destination airport code, e.g. 'JFK'. Shown large on the right of the route. - 'toCity' (string, optional): destination city name shown under the destination code. - 'flight' (string, recommended): flight number, e.g. 'AF128'. Shown bold on the stub. - 'date' (string, optional): travel date, e.g. 'Jul 12'. - 'boardingTime' (string, optional): boarding time, e.g. '10:05 AM'; labelled 'Boards'. - 'departTime' (string, optional): departure time, e.g. '10:35 AM'; labelled 'Departs'. - 'gate' (string, optional): departure gate, e.g. 'A12'. Shown bold on the stub. - 'terminal' (string, optional): departure terminal, e.g. '2'; part of the pass data. - 'seat' (string, optional): assigned seat, e.g. '12A'. Shown bold on the stub. - 'group' (string, optional): boarding group, e.g. 'B'. Shown bold on the stub. - 'status' (string, optional): e.g. 'Boarding' or 'On time'; rendered as a pill. - 'submitText' (string, optional): primary button label; defaults to 'Add to wallet'. - 'submitValue' (string, optional): the EXACT message sent back to the agent when the primary button is tapped; defaults to a sensible 'Add my boarding pass to my wallet' phrase. - 'secondaryText' (string, optional): a ghost secondary button label, e.g. 'Email pass'. Use these EXACT field names — they are the single contract the card reads.
